description: Produce a daily construction field report covering weather, crew, equipment, work completed, delays, and safety.

steps.description: Record the weather conditions at the job site for the day.

outputs.name: weather-record
outputs.desc: Temperature, precipitation, wind, and conditions log

outputs.name: weather-impact-note
outputs.desc: Any impact of weather on work activities

process: Record temperature, precipitation, wind speed, and sky conditions at morning, midday, and end of shift.
Note any weather-related work stoppages or delays.
Flag conditions that affect concrete pours, roofing, or other weather-sensitive activities.

steps.description: Document crew counts and hours worked by trade for the day.

outputs.name: crew-log
outputs.desc: Crew counts and hours by trade

outputs.name: labor-summary
outputs.desc: Total labor hours and headcount for the day

process: List each trade present on site (carpentry, electrical, plumbing, ironwork, etc.).
Record headcount and hours worked for each trade.
Note any overtime, short staffing, or no-shows.
Calculate the total labor hours for the day.

steps.description: Log all equipment present on the job site and its status.

outputs.name: equipment-log
outputs.desc: List of equipment on site with status

outputs.name: equipment-issues
outputs.desc: Any equipment breakdowns or needs

process: List each piece of equipment on site (cranes, excavators, lifts, generators).
Record operating status for each (active, idle, down for repair).
Note any equipment arriving or leaving the site.

steps.description: Describe the work completed on the job site for the day by area.

inputs.name: crew-log
inputs.desc: Crew counts and hours by trade

outputs.name: work-description
outputs.desc: Narrative of work completed by area

outputs.name: progress-notes
outputs.desc: Percent complete updates for active activities

process: Describe the work completed in each area of the site.
Reference the trades and equipment used for each activity.
Note any milestones reached or inspections passed.
Update the percent complete for each active activity.

steps.description: Document any delays, issues, or disruptions encountered during the day.

outputs.name: delay-log
outputs.desc: List of delays with cause, duration, and impact

outputs.name: issue-actions
outputs.desc: Actions taken or needed to resolve issues

process: List each delay or disruption with its cause (weather, material, labor, equipment, design).
Record the duration and the activities affected.
Document the actions taken to mitigate or resolve each issue.
Flag any issues requiring owner or architect attention.

steps.description: Capture safety observations and incidents from the day.

outputs.name: safety-observations
outputs.desc: Safety observations and any incidents

outputs.name: safety-actions
outputs.desc: Corrective actions taken for safety issues

process: Record any safety incidents, near misses, or first aid cases.
Document safety observations (positive and negative).
Note any safety meetings, toolbox talks, or training conducted.
List corrective actions taken for any violations.

steps.description: Compile all field data into the final daily field report.

inputs.name: crew-log
inputs.desc: Crew counts and hours by trade

outputs.name: daily-field-report
outputs.desc: Complete daily field report

outputs.name: report-distribution-list
outputs.desc: Recipients for the daily report

process: Assemble weather, crew, equipment, work, delay, and safety sections into the report template.
Add photos from the day to the appropriate sections.
Review the report for completeness and accuracy.
Distribute to the project team and file in the project records.

description: Manage a construction punch list from site walk through deficiency resolution.

steps.description: Walk the site with the architect or owner and document each deficiency.

inputs.name: walk-participants
inputs.desc: Names and roles of walk participants

outputs.name: deficiency-list
outputs.desc: List of deficiencies with location, description, and photo

outputs.name: walk-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of the punch walk findings

process: Walk each area of the project systematically.
Photograph and describe each deficiency with its exact location.
Categorize each item by severity (cosmetic, functional, code).
Number each item for tracking.

steps.description: Assign each punch list item to the responsible subcontractor.

inputs.name: deficiency-list
inputs.desc: List of deficiencies with location and description

outputs.name: assigned-punch-list
outputs.desc: Punch list with responsible party for each item

outputs.name: assignment-notices
outputs.desc: Notices sent to each subcontractor

process: Match each deficiency to the responsible subcontractor based on scope.
Set completion deadlines based on severity and project schedule.
Send the assignment notice with photos and descriptions to each sub.
Log the assignments in the punch list tracker.

steps.description: Track punch list item status and verify corrections.

inputs.name: assigned-punch-list
inputs.desc: Punch list with responsible parties and deadlines

outputs.name: status-report
outputs.desc: Current status of all punch list items

outputs.name: overdue-items
outputs.desc: Items past their completion deadline

process: Update item status as work is completed (open, in progress, complete, verified).
Re-inspect completed items to verify the correction.
Escalate overdue items to the project manager.
Track completion percentage and forecast the close-out date.

steps.description: Produce the punch list report with status summary and metrics.

inputs.name: status-report
inputs.desc: Current status of all punch list items

outputs.name: punch-list-report
outputs.desc: Final punch list report with status and metrics

outputs.name: sign-off-readiness
outputs.desc: Assessment of readiness for owner sign-off

process: Compile the status of all items into the report format.
Calculate metrics (total items, open, closed, overdue, percent complete).
Assess whether the project is ready for owner sign-off.
Distribute the report to the project team.

description: Manage requests for information from receipt through response distribution.

steps.description: Receive and log a request for information from the field.

inputs.name: originator
inputs.desc: Name and company of the person submitting the RFI

outputs.name: rfi-record
outputs.desc: Logged RFI with number, date, and subject

outputs.name: rfi-number
outputs.desc: Assigned RFI tracking number

process: Assign the next sequential RFI number.
Log the RFI with date, originator, subject, and description.
Attach any supporting drawings or photos.
Classify the urgency (routine, urgent, critical).

steps.description: Route the RFI to the architect, engineer, or other responsible party for response.

outputs.name: routing-confirmation
outputs.desc: Confirmation that the RFI was sent to the reviewer

outputs.name: response-deadline
outputs.desc: Date by which the response is expected

process: Identify the responsible party based on the RFI subject (architect, structural engineer, MEP engineer).
Send the RFI with all attachments to the reviewer.
Set the response deadline per the contract requirements.
Log the routing date and reviewer in the RFI log.

steps.description: Track the RFI response timeline and follow up on overdue items.

outputs.name: response-status
outputs.desc: Current status of the RFI response

outputs.name: response-content
outputs.desc: The response received from the reviewer

process: Monitor the response deadline.
Send reminders as the deadline approaches.
Log the response when received with date and content.
Flag any responses that require clarification or follow-up.

steps.description: Distribute the RFI response to affected parties and update project documents.

outputs.name: distribution-confirmation
outputs.desc: Confirmation that the response was distributed

outputs.name: document-updates
outputs.desc: List of project documents updated based on the response

process: Distribute the response to the originator and all affected subcontractors.
Update the project drawings or specifications if the response changes the design.
Close the RFI in the log.
File the complete RFI record in the project files.

steps.description: Produce the RFI log report with status metrics.

outputs.name: rfi-log-report
outputs.desc: Complete RFI log with status and metrics

outputs.name: rfi-metrics
outputs.desc: Metrics on RFI volume, response time, and open items

process: Compile all RFIs into the log report.
Calculate metrics (total, open, closed, average response time, overdue count).
Identify trends in RFI volume by trade or subject area.
Distribute the log report to the project team.

description: Track construction submittals from schedule preparation through distribution of approved documents.

steps.description: Prepare the submittal schedule from the project specifications.

outputs.name: submittal-schedule
outputs.desc: Schedule of all required submittals with due dates

outputs.name: submittal-responsibility-matrix
outputs.desc: Matrix of which subcontractor is responsible for each submittal

process: Extract all submittal requirements from the specifications.
Assign each submittal to the responsible subcontractor.
Set due dates based on procurement lead times and the construction schedule.
Distribute the schedule to all responsible parties.

steps.description: Route submittals to the architect for review and track turnaround.

outputs.name: review-status-log
outputs.desc: Status of each submittal in the review process

outputs.name: review-results
outputs.desc: Architect review results (approved, approved as noted, revise and resubmit, rejected)

process: Receive submittals from subcontractors and check for completeness.
Forward to the architect with the required review period noted.
Track the review status and follow up on overdue reviews.
Log the review result for each submittal.

steps.description: Distribute approved submittals to subcontractors and manage resubmittals.

inputs.name: review-results
inputs.desc: Architect review results for each submittal

outputs.name: distribution-log
outputs.desc: Log of approved submittals distributed to subcontractors

outputs.name: resubmittal-list
outputs.desc: List of submittals requiring resubmission

process: Distribute approved submittals to the responsible subcontractors.
Return rejected or revise-and-resubmit items to the subcontractor with the architect's comments.
Track resubmittals through the review cycle.
Update the submittal log with final status.

steps.description: Produce the submittal log report with status and metrics.

outputs.name: submittal-log-report
outputs.desc: Complete submittal log with status and metrics

outputs.name: submittal-metrics
outputs.desc: Metrics on submittal volume, turnaround time, and approval rates

process: Compile all submittals into the log report format.
Calculate metrics (total, approved, pending, rejected, average turnaround time).
Flag any submittals that are on the critical path.
Distribute the report to the project team.

description: Conduct a construction site safety inspection and track corrective actions.

steps.description: Walk the site against the safety checklist and document findings.

outputs.name: inspection-findings
outputs.desc: List of findings from the safety walk

outputs.name: violation-photos
outputs.desc: Photos documenting each violation

process: Walk the site systematically, checking fall protection, PPE compliance, housekeeping, electrical safety, and excavation safety.
Photograph each violation with its location.
Note positive observations and safe practices.
Classify each finding by severity (imminent danger, serious, other).

steps.description: Issue corrective actions for safety violations found during the inspection.

outputs.name: corrective-actions
outputs.desc: Corrective actions issued with deadlines

outputs.name: stop-work-orders
outputs.desc: Any stop-work orders for imminent danger conditions

process: Issue a corrective action for each violation with a specific deadline.
Issue a stop-work order for any imminent danger conditions.
Notify the responsible subcontractor in writing.
Log each action in the safety tracking system.

steps.description: Track the resolution of safety corrective actions.

outputs.name: resolution-status
outputs.desc: Status of each corrective action (open, resolved, overdue)

outputs.name: re-inspection-results
outputs.desc: Results of re-inspections verifying corrections

process: Monitor each corrective action against its deadline.
Re-inspect to verify the correction was made.
Escalate overdue items to the project manager and safety director.
Close the action when verified as resolved.

steps.description: Produce the safety inspection report with metrics.

outputs.name: safety-inspection-report
outputs.desc: Complete safety inspection report

outputs.name: safety-metrics
outputs.desc: Metrics on incident rate, violations, and resolution time

process: Compile all findings and corrective actions into the report.
Calculate safety metrics (total violations, resolution rate, average resolution time).
Track trends in violation types over time.
Distribute the report to the project team and safety committee.

description: Coordinate subcontractors on a construction site through scheduling, meetings, and progress tracking.

steps.description: Maintain the subcontractor contact list and scope matrix.

inputs.name: subcontractor-list
inputs.desc: List of subcontractors on the project

outputs.name: scope-matrix
outputs.desc: Matrix mapping each sub to their scope of work

outputs.name: contact-directory
outputs.desc: Contact directory for all subcontractors

process: List each subcontractor with their contract scope.
Map overlapping areas of work and interface points between subs.
Build the contact directory with project manager, superintendent, and emergency contacts.
Identify the subcontractors on the critical path.

steps.description: Hold the weekly subcontractor coordination meeting.

outputs.name: meeting-minutes
outputs.desc: Minutes from the coordination meeting

outputs.name: action-items
outputs.desc: Action items assigned during the meeting

process: Prepare the agenda covering schedule, access, deliveries, and conflicts.
Run the meeting with all subcontractor representatives.
Document decisions, commitments, and action items.
Distribute the minutes within 24 hours.

steps.description: Manage schedule conflicts and site access between subcontractors.

outputs.name: conflict-resolutions
outputs.desc: Resolved schedule conflicts with agreed plan

outputs.name: access-schedule
outputs.desc: Updated site access schedule by area and sub

process: Identify overlapping work in the same area or requiring the same access.
Negotiate the sequence with the affected subcontractors.
Update the site access schedule.
Communicate the resolution to all affected parties.

steps.description: Track subcontractor progress against the project schedule.

outputs.name: progress-report
outputs.desc: Subcontractor progress report by trade

outputs.name: schedule-variance
outputs.desc: Variance between planned and actual progress

process: Collect percent complete from each subcontractor weekly.
Compare actual progress against the baseline schedule.
Identify subcontractors falling behind and the cause.
Escalate schedule risks to the project manager.

steps.description: Produce the subcontractor coordination log.

outputs.name: coordination-log
outputs.desc: Complete coordination log with meeting notes, conflicts, and progress

outputs.name: coordination-metrics
outputs.desc: Metrics on meetings held, conflicts resolved, and schedule adherence

process: Compile meeting minutes, conflict resolutions, and progress data.
Calculate coordination metrics.
Identify recurring coordination issues for process improvement.
File the log in the project records.

description: Track material procurement from takeoff through delivery and receipt inspection.

steps.description: Extract the material list from the project documents.

outputs.name: material-list
outputs.desc: List of materials needed with quantities and specifications

outputs.name: delivery-schedule
outputs.desc: Required delivery dates based on the construction schedule

process: Extract material quantities from the drawings and specifications.
Group materials by specification section and trade.
Set required delivery dates based on when each activity starts.
Flag long-lead items requiring early procurement.

steps.description: Solicit quotes from suppliers and issue purchase orders.

outputs.name: purchase-orders
outputs.desc: Issued purchase orders

outputs.name: supplier-commitments
outputs.desc: Confirmed delivery dates from suppliers

process: Send quote requests to at least three suppliers per material.
Compare quotes on price, lead time, and terms.
Issue purchase orders for the selected suppliers.
Confirm delivery dates and log the commitments.

steps.description: Track material delivery dates and manage backorders.

outputs.name: delivery-status
outputs.desc: Status of each material delivery

outputs.name: backorder-list
outputs.desc: Materials that are backordered or delayed

process: Monitor delivery dates against the commitments.
Follow up with suppliers on approaching deliveries.
Log actual delivery dates and any discrepancies.
Manage backorders by finding substitute suppliers or materials.

steps.description: Inspect materials on receipt for quantity and quality.

outputs.name: receipt-record
outputs.desc: Record of materials received with inspection results

outputs.name: rejection-notices
outputs.desc: Notices for rejected or deficient materials

process: Verify the quantity received against the packing slip and purchase order.
Inspect the materials for damage, correct specifications, and quality.
Issue rejection notices for deficient materials.
Store accepted materials in the designated laydown area.

steps.description: Produce the material tracking log with procurement metrics.

outputs.name: material-tracking-log
outputs.desc: Complete material tracking log

outputs.name: procurement-metrics
outputs.desc: Metrics on procurement lead time, on-time delivery, and rejection rate

process: Compile all procurement data into the tracking log.
Calculate metrics (on-time delivery rate, rejection rate, average lead time).
Flag materials still outstanding that could impact the schedule.
Distribute the log to the project team.

description: Update the construction schedule with field progress data and assess schedule impacts.

steps.description: Collect progress data from the field for schedule update.

inputs.name: update-period
inputs.desc: Date range for the schedule update

outputs.name: progress-data
outputs.desc: Percent complete and actual dates for each activity

outputs.name: field-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on conditions affecting progress

process: Walk the site and assess percent complete for each active activity.
Record actual start and finish dates for completed activities.
Note any conditions affecting progress (weather, access, labor, material).
Collect input from subcontractor superintendents.

steps.description: Update activity percent complete and dates in the schedule.

outputs.name: updated-schedule
outputs.desc: Schedule with current progress data

outputs.name: critical-path-changes
outputs.desc: Any changes to the critical path

process: Enter percent complete for each activity.
Record actual start and finish dates.
Recalculate the critical path.
Identify any new critical or near-critical activities.

steps.description: Assess the impact of delays on the project completion date.

outputs.name: impact-assessment
outputs.desc: Assessment of delay impacts on completion date

outputs.name: recovery-options
outputs.desc: Options to recover lost time

process: Compare the current completion date against the baseline.
Identify the activities causing the delay.
Evaluate recovery options (overtime, additional crews, resequencing, acceleration).
Estimate the cost and feasibility of each recovery option.

steps.description: Produce the schedule update report for the project team.

outputs.name: schedule-update-report
outputs.desc: Complete schedule update report with narrative and metrics

outputs.name: schedule-metrics
outputs.desc: Metrics on schedule performance (SPI, days ahead or behind)

process: Write the schedule narrative covering progress, delays, and recovery plan.
Calculate the schedule performance index (SPI).
Include a bar chart or Gantt view of the current schedule.
Distribute the report to the owner, architect, and project team.

description: Conduct a construction quality inspection at hold points and track non-conformances.

steps.description: Identify the inspection hold points from the project specifications.

outputs.name: hold-point-schedule
outputs.desc: Schedule of upcoming inspection hold points

outputs.name: inspection-criteria
outputs.desc: Acceptance criteria for each hold point

process: Extract all inspection hold points from the specifications.
Map each hold point to the construction schedule.
Define the acceptance criteria for each inspection.
Notify the subcontractors of upcoming inspections.

steps.description: Inspect the work against the standards and document findings.

outputs.name: inspection-results
outputs.desc: Results of each inspection (pass, fail, conditional)

outputs.name: finding-photos
outputs.desc: Photos documenting the inspection findings

process: Inspect the work against the acceptance criteria.
Document each finding with photos and measurements.
Record the inspection result (pass, fail, conditional pass).
Note any deviations that require engineering review.

steps.description: Issue non-conformance reports for failed inspections.

outputs.name: non-conformance-reports
outputs.desc: NCRs issued for each failure

outputs.name: remediation-requirements
outputs.desc: Required corrective work for each NCR

process: Issue a non-conformance report for each failed inspection.
Describe the deficiency and reference the specification requirement.
Specify the required remediation work.
Set the deadline for correction and re-inspection.

steps.description: Produce the quality inspection record with metrics.

outputs.name: quality-inspection-record
outputs.desc: Complete quality inspection record

outputs.name: quality-metrics
outputs.desc: Metrics on inspection pass rate, NCR volume, and resolution time

process: Compile all inspection results and NCRs into the quality record.
Calculate metrics (pass rate, NCR count, average resolution time).
Identify trends in non-conformance types.
File the record in the project quality files.

description: Compile project closeout documentation for handover to the owner.

steps.description: Collect and verify as-built drawings from all trades.

inputs.name: drawing-list
inputs.desc: List of all project drawings requiring as-built markup

outputs.name: as-built-drawings
outputs.desc: Complete set of as-built drawings

outputs.name: drawing-gaps
outputs.desc: Any drawings not yet received

process: Request as-built markups from each subcontractor.
Verify that each drawing reflects the actual installed conditions.
Track receipt and flag missing drawings.
Submit the as-built set to the architect for final review.

steps.description: Gather warranties, guarantees, and operation manuals.

outputs.name: warranty-package
outputs.desc: All warranties and guarantees organized by system

outputs.name: om-manuals
outputs.desc: Operation and maintenance manuals for all systems

process: Collect warranties from each subcontractor and supplier.
Organize by building system (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, roofing, etc.).
Gather the operation and maintenance manuals for each system.
Verify that all required warranties match the specification requirements.

steps.description: Assemble all test and inspection reports.

outputs.name: test-reports
outputs.desc: Complete set of test and inspection reports

outputs.name: test-gaps
outputs.desc: Any required tests not yet documented

process: Collect all test reports (concrete, steel, soil, air balance, fire alarm, etc.).
Verify that each required test was performed and documented.
Cross-reference against the specification requirements.
Flag any missing tests for immediate scheduling.

steps.description: Compile all closeout documents into the final package for the owner.

outputs.name: closeout-package
outputs.desc: Complete closeout package for the owner

outputs.name: closeout-transmittal
outputs.desc: Transmittal letter documenting the delivery

process: Organize all documents into the closeout package format per the contract.
Include the punch list sign-off and certificate of substantial completion.
Prepare the transmittal letter listing all delivered documents.
Deliver the package to the owner and file a copy in the project records.
